title: Lab - Gateway API
description: Route traffic with a Gateway and an HTTPRoute.
scenario: Route traffic with a Gateway and an HTTPRoute. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - CRDs
tasks.instructions: Install the Gateway API CRDs and a controller (nginx-gateway or similar).

tasks.title: Task 2 - Gateway
tasks.instructions: Create Gateway nginx-gateway in namespace nginx-gateway listening on HTTP 80.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Route
tasks.instructions: Create an HTTPRoute sending /web to web-service:80.
tasks.solution: # kind: HTTPRoute with parentRefs to the gateway and a path match
